C0436.title: PayPal Warns of Surge in Carding Attacks Driving Global Losses
C0436.summary: PayPal reports that carding attacks increased by 134% year-over-year in 2022. Attackers purchase stolen credit card information from the dark web or obtain it through phishing, then use automated scripts to launch numerous small-value transaction attempts on merchant websites to validate the card credentials. Successfully verified cards are subsequently used to purchase high-value goods or resold
